svg.title: Physarum flux-reinforcement model on a small mesh
svg.desc: Top: one fixed source-sink pair reduces a mesh to its shortest path. Bottom: a source-sink pair redrawn every iteration gives networks whose loop count falls as the exponent mu rises.
svg.text: Flux-reinforcing adaptation on a 9 x 6 jittered triangular mesh
dD/dt = |Q|^mu - D, Kirchhoff pressures re-solved every step. Line width = conductivity D; pale dots are food nodes; tubes with D < 0.02 are drawn as faint mesh.
A pair redrawn each iteration from the six food nodes (final state, 1500 steps)
